verdict.rationale: Letta ships an official CLI (Letta Code) with documented commands (/agents, /fork, /remember, /doctor), headless/non-interactive mode for CI/CD, and a runtime probe confirming the npm CLI installs and runs keylessly. This is corroborated by both first-party docs and a live runtime check. Missing for 10: independent third-party review of the CLI itself beyond vendor docs/probe.
